fact: The Uganda National Health Compact (2025-2030), adopted December 2025, commits under action 2.9 to scale up the use of EMRS and DHIS2 to all facilities, interoperable with eLMIS, mTRAC, eCHIS and health registries, with a target of 100% of hospitals and 80% of HC IVs and IIIs reporting in real time by 2028, the Ministry of Health, local governments and development partners responsible; it also says many digital health initiatives are project-funded by donors and names no domestic budget line for DHIS2.
title: Uganda National Health Compact (2025-2030)
